integrity: The universal theorem follows from analytic integral identities and exact coefficient inequalities; attached finite checks only cross-test calculations. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local for fixed 0<alpha<1, beta>alpha, p>0 and perturbations small in both H-infinity and the alpha Hilbert norm. No global deficit or large-parameter uniformity is proved; older equivalent stability estimates remain a residual priority risk.
title: Sharp local stability of the Dirichlet-range Hardy–Littlewood contraction
